lines.text: *Jingle*

lines.speaker: femaleemployee
lines.text: Welcome!

lines.speaker: femaleemployee
lines.text: Please take a seat wherever you like.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: femaleemployee
lines.text: Here's the menu. Call me when you're ready to order.
Let's see...

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Most things here are pretty good,

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: but personally, I'd recommend the house special beef bowl.
I'll get that, then. I trust you.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: G-good.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: I'll have that too.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Excuse me!

lines.speaker: femaleemployee
lines.text: Are you all ready to order?

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Two house special beef bowls, please.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: And one beer.
Oh? You're drinking?

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Yeah. I like having a drink after work.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Would you like one too, Mr. {AccountData.NickName}?
Sure.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: All right.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Then two beers, please.

lines.speaker: femaleemployee
lines.text: Sure thing!
Before long, the food and drinks arrive.

lines.speaker: femaleemployee
lines.text: Enjoy!
Thank you.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: It might not be wise to drink on an empty stomach, but...

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: shall we toast first?
We clink our glasses together.
*Gulp, gulp*

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Ahhh!
I didn't realize you liked drinking, Privaty.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Oh, just as much as anyone.
Privaty has a big smile on her face. She seems to be in a better mood than before.
You keep smiling. Did something good happen?

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Wh-what do you mean? I-I'm not smiling that much...!

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Nothing in particular happened, per se.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: I just...

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: wanted us to talk a bit while we eat.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: If you think of it, we're colleagues now, right?
That's true.
What would two colleagues talk about over dinner...?
Is there anything you've been struggling with at work lately?
Have you heard any interesting rumors at school?

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Hm...

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Oh.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: I don't know if you could call it struggling, but...

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: sometimes I feel like I'm not very good at handling the students.
Really? It seems to me like you're doing good.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: I'm glad you think that way.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: But when it comes to talking to the students, I don't think anyone's nearly as good as you, Mr. {AccountData.NickName}.
Me?

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: You just have this way of making the students feel comfortable.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: ... Actually,

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: not just the students, but... everyone...
Hm? What was that?

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: N-nothing.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Anyway, I just find it impressive. I'm jealous.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Sometimes I even think you would make a better homeroom teacher than me.
What're you talking about? You're the best homeroom teacher anyone could hope for.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: R-really?
I mean, when it comes to practical lessons, you know how bad I am.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: That's not your fault, though. We are, quite literally, built differently.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Your specialty is teaching theory based on real combat experience.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: The students follow you, and you excel in specific subjects.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: I think that makes you a great fit as a homeroom teacher, don't you?
I don't have your kind of charisma.
It's nice when a teacher feels like a friend, but I still think a teacher should be a teacher.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: I must say...

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: I completely agree!

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: You and I really work well together, don't you think?
We're basically the perfect duo.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Haha, that makes me happy to hear.
Privaty and I once again clink our glasses together.
*Gulp, gulp*

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: You're done eating, right?

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: It's still early. Want to go for a second round?

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Interesting rumors?

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Not really...

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: I'm mostly buried in work, and you're closer to the students than I am, Mr. {AccountData.NickName}.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: You probably hear more than I do.
From the students? Maybe, but their rumors aren't all that interesting.
I was thinking more of something like a scandal between coworkers. That'd be more relevant to us, don't you think?

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: A s-scandal?!

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: What in the world are you thinking of while you're at school...!?

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Everyone here except for you is a Nikke.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: They're not going to be causing any scandals among themselves.
In other words... you're saying there could be a scandal if it involves me.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Th-th-theoretically... yes.
And right now, it's just the two of us here, eating together.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: C-colleagues having dinner together is normal...!
Also, we're together all the time.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: That's just because we're teachers to the same homeroom!

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Ugh...!

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Stop saying weird things!
*Gulp, gulp*
Whoa, you downed that a little fast, don't you think?

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: It's fine. Hurry up and finish yours.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: We're going for a second round.
... Seriously?
What's wrong? Didn't you say we're going for a second round?

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: ... Do you, uh, know anywhere good?
Not really. I don't know this area that well.
You sounded so confident when you brought it up, I thought you'd take me somewhere you frequent.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: I-I don't have anywhere like that!

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Honestly, it's been so long since I even went out drinking with someone else.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: ... Should we just pick a place and go in?
Privaty's cheeks are slightly flushed.
If she drinks more, she might get drunk...
We've got class tomorrow. Let's just walk around a bit and head back.
How about that place over there? Looks like they serve shish kebabs, too.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Hmm... Yeah, maybe you're right.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Now that we're out here walking, I actually do feel a little tipsy.
We walk through a park together to sober up.
It's quiet enough to hear our footsteps as we go.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Ahh, the air's pleasantly cool. It feels nice.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: I don't think I've ever gone for a walk like this after drinking.
Really?

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Yeah. I'm not really a big drinker to begin with.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: When I drink, it's usually one or two cans of beer in my room.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Coming out and drinking like this is actually really nice.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: ... Thank you. For doing this with me.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Ugh, I really must be tipsy.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: I don't know why I said any of that...!

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Wh-whoa...!
Privaty starts to lose her balance.
I grab her hand as she stumbles.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Phew... Thank you.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: We should probably head back now.
Yeah, let's go.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Uh, you can let go of my hand now.
I was just worried.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: I just lost my balance earlier.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: I'm really not that drunk, so you can let go...

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Wh...

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: When people say that, it usually means they're drunk, or so I've heard.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: I-I know it might make you a little uncomfortable, but... please keep holding my hand so I don't fall.
Okay.
Privaty lowers her head.
Privaty, let me see your face.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: N-no.
You're definitely not that drunk.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: R-right...?

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: I suppose that means you can let go of my hand...
Actually, I think I'm still a bit drunk, so could we just keep holding hands?

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: W-well if you put it that way...

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: I guess I have no choice.
We continue to hold hands the entire way to the dorm.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Shish kebabs?

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Sure. Let's go.
I'm a little worried about tomorrow,
but we head into the kebab place together.
